title: New Home in DT Gilbert-Heated Pool, Fire Pits, BBQ
description:
Paradise on Palm-Newest Home in DT Gilbert-Sleeps 12-located in the heart of Downtown Gilbert- Heated Pool

 The space 
Just a short walk to The heart of Downtown and fantastic times. Joe's BBQ, Snooze, Dierk's Bentley Whiskey Row, the Gilbert Farmer's Market, Hale Theatre & more are a moment away! This home features 2 wings consisting of 2 Full kitchens, 5 bedrooms, 4 bathrooms, and an incredible loft and balcony. this home can comfortably accommodate a total of 12 people.

The yard is perfect for entertaining- complete with (2) gas fireplaces, (2) Gas BBQ's & incredible view of the Gilbert Water Tower! Enjoy the fireplace and Pool outside as you gather around with friends and family. Parties or events are not allowed.

This is Down Town Gilberts newest addition to the market. This home was just constructed from the ground up.

Televisions-
There are Eight SMART televisions throughout the home including every bedroom. HULU, NETFLIX etc are accessible with your personal logon information.

Heating Pool Requires 2 days notice at an additional charge of 55.00 per day

Pets are allowed at 75.00 per animal , Over 50 lbs needs prior approval as well as multiple pet situations- Pet owners assume the responsibility for any and all damages. No Dogs allowed in the pool.

 Other things to note
